title: No behavioural test that `termal sessions resume-paused --dry-run` sends dryRun:true
outcome: A test parses `termal sessions resume-paused --dry-run` and checks, against the existing fake HTTP server fixture, that the CLI sends exactly one POST to /api/queues/resume-paused with dryRun:true. A wiring regression that sends dryRun:false for a preview fails the test.
acceptance: No behavioural test that `termal sessions resume-paused --dry-run` sends dryRun:true is done
